goal: Allow running txindex concurrently with block pruning
Let pruned node operators index full transaction history without keeping the entire blockchain on disk
Enable RPC and REST callers to identify pruned transactions and re-fetch missing blocks on demand
reviewability: Author addressed previous reviewer feedback and updated the implementation
agreement: Strong support for making pruned nodes more capable with transaction lookups
Concept approval for indexing transactions on pruned nodes (optout21, ajtowns, l0rinc)
Previous objections on race conditions and interface types were resolved (l0rinc, fjahr)
Minor open suggestion on gettxoutproof and question on error details remain (arejula27, fjahr)

categories.name: indexes
why: P2 because it fulfills long-standing requests allowing pruned nodes to maintain transaction index data
Operators avoid keeping full block history on disk while retaining historical lookup capabilities

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because callers can reliably distinguish missing transactions from pruned transactions
Returns candidate block hashes so clients can retrieve missing blocks via getblockfrompeer
